check_coverage.read_only_justification: Only answers whether a location is inside a service area; stores nothing and changes nothing.
check_coverage.destructive_justification: Performs no booking, charge, deletion or overwrite.
check_coverage.open_world_justification: Looks up RentADriver's own service-area data; the address is geocoded server-side as part of that lookup, and nothing is sent to or changed at any third party.

list_service_areas.read_only_justification: Lists the configured service areas only.

get_quote.read_only_justification: Prices a trip. The server stores a 15-minute pricing snapshot so a later create_delivery can reference the same price, but nothing is booked, held or charged and nothing is visible or needs undoing if unused.
get_quote.destructive_justification: No booking, payment, dispatch, deletion or overwrite.
get_quote.open_world_justification: Computed from RentADriver's own tariffs and route estimate; no driver, merchant or third party is contacted.

list_intercity_lanes.read_only_justification: Lists each city's neighbouring cities within 160 km with a same-day sample price.
list_intercity_lanes.open_world_justification: Computed from RentADriver's own list of launch cities.

get_intercity_quote.read_only_justification: Prices a same-day trip to a neighbouring city; like get_quote it stores only an expiring pricing snapshot, with no booking, hold or charge.
get_intercity_quote.destructive_justification: No booking, payment, dispatch, deletion or overwrite.
get_intercity_quote.open_world_justification: Computed from RentADriver's own city rate cards; nobody outside the platform is contacted.

list_country_workspaces.read_only_justification: Lists the account's country workspaces and balances.
list_country_workspaces.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own account.

enable_country_workspace.read_only_justification: Creates a new country workspace in the account, so it writes.
enable_country_workspace.destructive_justification: Additive: starts at zero balance and leaves existing workspaces and money untouched.
enable_country_workspace.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own account.

signup.read_only_justification: Creates a new RentADriver account and API key.
signup.destructive_justification: Creates a new account; deletes or overwrites nothing and moves no money.
signup.open_world_justification: Creates an account inside RentADriver only; a verification email goes only to the address the user supplied.

check_account_status.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own account.

get_wallet_balance.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own account.

create_wallet_deposit.read_only_justification: Creates a Stripe Checkout link for the account.
create_wallet_deposit.destructive_justification: No money moves: the link only charges if a human opens it and pays in Stripe's own confirmation screen.
create_wallet_deposit.open_world_justification: Returns a checkout link for the caller's own account; nothing leaves the account until a human completes payment themselves.

create_x402_deposit.destructive_justification: Returns payment requirements only; no funds move until the caller signs a payment separately.
create_x402_deposit.open_world_justification: The payment it prepares settles on a public blockchain (USDC on Base), outside RentADriver.

set_spending_controls.destructive_justification: Overwrites the previous caps (null clears them), so earlier values are replaced.
set_spending_controls.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own account.

list_api_keys.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own account.

create_api_key.destructive_justification: Additive: existing keys keep working and nothing is deleted or charged.
create_api_key.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own account.

revoke_api_key.destructive_justification: Permanent: the revoked key can never be used again.
revoke_api_key.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own account.

create_delivery.destructive_justification: Holds real wallet funds (unless fund=false) and starts dispatch; cancelling after a driver is assigned costs a fee. dryRun=true validates without booking.
create_delivery.open_world_justification: Dispatches the job to real independent drivers and notifies the recipient.

create_store_pickup.destructive_justification: Holds real wallet funds and starts dispatch, like create_delivery.
create_store_pickup.open_world_justification: Dispatches real independent drivers and involves the store and recipient.

create_batch.destructive_justification: Holds real wallet funds for every delivery and starts dispatch.
create_batch.open_world_justification: Dispatches real independent drivers for each delivery.

fund_delivery.destructive_justification: Holds real wallet funds and releases the delivery to dispatch.

get_delivery.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own deliveries.

list_deliveries.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own deliveries.

create_recipient_code.read_only_justification: Creates or replaces a handover code for a stop.
create_recipient_code.destructive_justification: Replacing invalidates the previous code, overwriting it.
create_recipient_code.open_world_justification: The code is returned to the caller only; RentADriver sends it to nobody.

track_delivery.read_only_justification: Reads live status, ETA and position.
track_delivery.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own deliveries.

get_delivery_events.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own deliveries.

update_delivery.destructive_justification: Overwrites the instructions, contingency or drop-off contact previously stored.
update_delivery.open_world_justification: The change is stored on the caller's own delivery.

cancel_delivery.destructive_justification: Irreversible: a cancelled delivery cannot be resumed, and after assignment a cancellation fee is charged.
cancel_delivery.open_world_justification: Changes only the caller's own delivery; the assigned driver's app simply drops the job.

create_return.read_only_justification: Books the reverse leg as a new delivery.
create_return.destructive_justification: Creates and funds a new real delivery, holding wallet money.

send_message_to_driver.destructive_justification: Additive: adds a message to the delivery thread, deleting, overwriting or charging nothing.
send_message_to_driver.open_world_justification: Delivered as a push and in-app message to the assigned driver, an independent person outside the account.

get_delivery_messages.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own deliveries.

get_proof_of_delivery.read_only_justification: Reads photos, signature and codes captured at handover.
get_proof_of_delivery.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own deliveries.

confirm_delivery.destructive_justification: Irreversibly releases the held payment to the driver.
confirm_delivery.open_world_justification: Pays an independent driver outside the account.

open_dispute.destructive_justification: Additive and reversible: funds simply stay held while RentADriver reviews; nothing is deleted, paid or overwritten.
open_dispute.open_world_justification: Handled by RentADriver's own operations team.

tip_driver.destructive_justification: Irreversibly moves wallet money to the driver.
tip_driver.open_world_justification: Pays an independent driver outside the account.

rate_driver.destructive_justification: Additive feedback on a completed delivery; moves no money and deletes nothing.
rate_driver.open_world_justification: Stored inside RentADriver; the driver is not contacted.

list_shopify_orders.read_only_justification: Lists the connected Shopify store's orders.
list_shopify_orders.open_world_justification: Reads only the caller's own connected store.

book_shopify_order.read_only_justification: Books a delivery for a Shopify order.
book_shopify_order.destructive_justification: Holds real wallet funds, starts dispatch and fulfils the order in Shopify.
book_shopify_order.open_world_justification: Dispatches real independent drivers and writes fulfilment/tracking back to Shopify.

list_store_orders.read_only_justification: Lists orders from the caller's connected store.
list_store_orders.open_world_justification: Reads only the caller's own connected store.

book_store_order.read_only_justification: Books a delivery for a store order.
book_store_order.destructive_justification: Holds real wallet funds and starts dispatch.
book_store_order.open_world_justification: Dispatches real independent drivers and updates the order on the store platform.

register_webhook.destructive_justification: Additive: adds a subscription, deleting, overwriting or charging nothing.
register_webhook.open_world_justification: RentADriver will POST delivery events to an arbitrary caller-supplied URL.

list_webhooks.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own account.

delete_webhook.destructive_justification: Deactivates the webhook permanently; queued deliveries to it stop.
delete_webhook.open_world_justification: Bounded to the caller's own account.
